# Ticket Classification & Routing

**Fixture:** customer-support-2026-09-16-v2-technical
**User:** user_a

## Query
> "The mobile app crashes with an error and is not working after the update."

## Classification

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **category** | `technical` (Technical Issue) |
| **owner_team** | Technical Support |
| **priority** | P2 |
| **sla** | 1 business day |

**Why this category:** The query matches these keywords for the `technical` category: **"app"**, **"crash"** (as "crashes"), **"error"**, **"not working"** and **"update"**. `technical` is also the configured `default_category`, so the classification holds either way.

## Routing Decision
Route to **Technical Support** at **P2**, with a **1 business day** SLA.

## Policy Application
Frozen policy: *"Collect reproduction steps and device information, then route to technical support for diagnosis."*

- The ticket goes to Technical Support for diagnosis.
- The query does not include reproduction steps or device information, so we must collect these as part of the handoff.

## Next Actions
1. **Collect reproduction steps.** Ask what the user does just before the crash, such as launching the app or opening a specific screen, and whether it happens every time.
2. **Ask for the device and app version.** Request the device model, OS version and the app version installed after the update.
3. **Route to Technical Support with logs if available.** Ask for the exact error message, a screenshot, or crash logs, and attach whatever the user provides to the ticket.

## Missing Information
The supplied data does not include the following, and none of it has been assumed:
- Device model and operating system
- App version, and which update triggered the issue
- Exact error message text or code
- Reproduction steps and how often the crash happens
- Crash logs or screenshots
- Any account history or earlier tickets for `user_a` (`shared_context` is empty)

## Suggested Customer Reply
> Thanks for letting us know, and sorry the app is crashing after the update. To help our Technical Support team diagnose this, could you please share:
> - Your device model and OS version
> - The app version you're currently on
> - The exact error message you see (a screenshot is helpful)
> - The steps that lead to the crash, and whether it happens every time
>
> Once we have these details, your ticket will be handled by Technical Support within 1 business day.

isolation.fresh_session: one process and clean temporary workdir per call

sampling_parameters: not explicitly set by this experiment
